fields.captureRule: Capture route at successful explicit gameStore answer_will_change(let_it_be) versus automatic advanceMarriage deadline path. Bind capture to negotiationId/rivalID/answer tick and carry immutable reference to later contested emission. Require exact matching plan.rival and source inheritance rival branch. Do not infer explicit intent from same willAnswer or late tick. A bot command is explicit command route, not necessarily human intention. Missing reference unknown. ADDED DEATH/IDENTITY GUARD: For BOTH contested variants, at the inheritance operation require oldLord exists, is the same pinned bride-father person ID from the original contract, and actual death is verified at that event (alive=false with death evidence tied to the same person and transition). Match counterpart estateId, brideId, negotiationId and rivalId to the saved will-answer reference. Missing oldLord, absent/mismatched death evidence or identity -> unknown/baseline; never treat source !alive on missing lookup as proof of death. Never inspect current survivors to backfill this guard. Before/after rule: use the actual death transition with this same person present before alive=true and after alive=false, OR an exact immutable death record for that person captured earlier and verified before the contested inheritance emission. Inheritance before/after alone may already have alive=false on both sides and is not proof of a new death. A missing person on either side, no verified death record, changed estate lord or mismatched contract identity yields unknown; do not synthesize a death from lookup failure.
